name: Krybdis
source:
Head Researcher of the Calliste-17 unit. A keen eye for science and resourceful to the core. She is going to survive this horror show, and discover more about herself. Whether she wants to or not.

"I need to focus on what I know, not what I can't remember."

[From [url=https://helloyinny.itch.io/deep-breaths]itch.io[/url]]
